# TensorFlow on Python 3.14 (2026-10): stable tensorflow has no 3.14 wheels until
# 2.22 ships, so the TF stack is pinned to nightlies. Every package below that
# decides what `tf.keras` resolves to is pinned, so rebuilding the same commit
# (e.g. via workflow_dispatch) yields the same Keras.
#
#   - `tf.keras` is Keras 3 (keras-nightly). TF_USE_LEGACY_KERAS is deliberately
#     NOT set in the image: this image has shipped Keras 3 to graders since
#     tf-nightly replaced stable tensorflow (9982ecd), and check50 checks are
#     written against it.
#   - tf-keras-nightly (Keras 2) is installed only because transformers' TF model
#     classes import `tf_keras` directly. Loading those classes sets
#     TF_USE_LEGACY_KERAS=1 within that process, which routes `tf.keras` to Keras 2
#     there if it has not been resolved yet; a job that imports tensorflow alone
#     is unaffected.
#   - tf-nightly and tf-keras-nightly must come from the same 2.22.0.dev line
#     (tf-keras-nightly requires tf-nightly~=2.22.0.dev). dev20260924 is the last
#     2.22 tf-nightly; there is no tf-keras-nightly build for that date, so the
#     nearest one is used.
#   - PyPI keeps roughly 8-9 months of tf-nightly builds (keras-nightly keeps all).
#     Exit path, before ~mid-2027: tensorflow==2.22.x + tf-keras==2.22.x once they
#     ship cp314 wheels, then drop keras-nightly (tensorflow 2.22 pins keras itself).
tf-nightly==2.22.0.dev20260924
keras-nightly==3.16.0.dev2026102404
tf-keras-nightly==2.22.0.dev2026101709
# 4.57.6 is the last 4.x release; 5.x drops TensorFlow support (TFBertForMaskedLM et al.)
transformers==4.57.6

# check50 and lib50
git+https://github.com/cs50/check50.git@4.0.0-dev#egg=check50
git+https://github.com/cs50/lib50.git@develop#egg=lib50
